name: sticker-face-blue-sky
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: bright flash-lit snapshot photography, close crop from a low angle, slightly soft focus with a candid Y2K-selfie feel.
· GROUND: a wide-open cyan-blue summer sky with soft wispy white clouds filling the whole background.
· LIGHT: hard warm golden sunlight from the upper front, glossy sheen on skin, luminous saturated highlights.
· STICKERS: small die-cut glossy stickers pressed flat across the skin — smiley faces, daisies, hearts, stars — in candy colours (pink, mint, lilac, yellow, blue).
· HARDWARE: chunky Y2K silver jewellery — star-shaped nose ring, stacked ear cuffs, thin ball chains — plus dark sunglasses pushed up.
· PALETTE: sky-blue and cloud-white, warm brown skin, lilac garment, and multicolour candy sticker accents.
· MOOD: giddy, sun-drenched, playful and carefree; fine photographic grain over saturated colour.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
